
### Models superimposed on data

We can graph our fitted models on each scale (probability, [odds](binary-outcome-associations.qmd#def-odds),
[log-odds](binary-outcome-associations.qmd#def-logodds)).

{{< slidebreak >}}

#### probability scale

:::{#fig-fitted-probs-chd}

```{r}
curve_type_A <- function(x) { # nolint: object_name_linter
  chd_glm_contrasts |> predict(
    type = "response",
    newdata = tibble(age = x, dibpat = "Type A")
  )
}

curve_type_B <- function(x) { # nolint: object_name_linter
  chd_glm_contrasts |> predict(
    type = "response",
    newdata = tibble(age = x, dibpat = "Type B")
  )
}

chd_plot_probs_2 <-
  chd_plot_probs +
  geom_function(
    fun = curve_type_A,
    aes(col = "Type A")
  ) +
  geom_function(
    fun = curve_type_B,
    aes(col = "Type B")
  )
print(chd_plot_probs_2)
```

Fitted CHD [risk](binary-outcome-associations.qmd#def-risk-epi) by age and behavior pattern (probability scale)

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

#### odds scale
